Name: Christmas - The Decorating (DGA)
Author: AmuTsukiyomi
Description:
I was asked by CyanFire if they could make a DGA version of the original CF mod.  I told them I'd like to try doing it myself first.....which took a while, but I've managed it!

[color=#9900ff][size=5][u][b]THANK YOU CYANFIRE![/b][/u] [size=2](I was wrong, they contacted  me on Nexus, not Discord, no wonder I couldn't find the DM in discord!)[/size][/size][/color]

This version of Christmas- The Decorating has a whole bunch of new assets. There's about 195 total now.  Plus, DGA lats you put things outside, seemingly without any problems, so now you can do up the outside too!

All you need is SMAPI, SpaceCore, ContentPatcher, and DGA.
Just unzip Christmas- The Decorating into the Mods folder in SDV and you're good to go!
